g.text: Decode is memory-bound, prefill is compute-bound (Qwen3-4B FP8, one L4)

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'system-ui', '-apple-system', 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Left of the ridge (FP8 ≈ 552 FLOP/B) a step waits on memory; right of it, on the tensor cores. Labels: batch size (decode), prompt tokens (prefill).

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'system-ui', '-apple-system', 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: Solid roofs: measured best sustained cuBLAS GEMM and copy bandwidth under the 72 W cap. Dotted: datasheet (FP8 242 TFLOPS, 300 GB/s). Kernel times from torch.profiler.
